faq.q: Is my data secure and private?
faq.a: Yes, NEXUS uses full end-to-end encryption (AES-256) and never shares data with third parties.

faq.q: How do I connect a new app like Notion or Slack?
faq.a: Navigate to Profile → Integrations, and click 'Connect' next to the desired service.

faq.q: What is 'Context' and how is it determined?
faq.a: Context represents your active environment (Work, Family, Learning) inferred from calendar, time, and location.

faq.q: How can I permanently delete my data?
faq.a: In Settings → Privacy, you can export your data or click 'Purge All Data'.
